nr1883.summary: A buying order to Stomoniakov in Berlin: hardware for the goods-exchange fund with the countryside, listed with sizes (iron, nails, shovels, rakes, forks, axes, saws, chisels). It ends "continuation follows". The goods-exchange subject fits the Politburo decision on Kopp's proposal of 16 April 1921, by subject only.

snip.credit: NARA RG 59, 861.00, M316 roll 42, frame 1273, via the National Archives Catalog

system: A columnar transposition of Russian in Latin letters: frequencies are Russian with no substitution, and the recovered key gives Russian text. Q is the soft or hard sign; punctuation is spelled out.
